acquisition_contract.method: HTTPS Range requests to immutable Hugging Face resolve URLs; safetensors header offsets plus byte hashes bind each extracted tensor. No complete checkpoint and no AutoModelForCausalLM load are required.

manifest.weights: exact q/k/v projections, q/k norms, o_proj for layer 0 sliding attention and layer 5 full attention; rows 0..383 of the official embedding matrix

official_module_producer.producer_path: official embedding -> q_proj/k_proj/(v_proj where present) -> official q_norm/k_norm (the unfused official equivalent of the runtime fused QKV RMSNorm) -> official rotary embedding; the unchanged official o_proj consumes the attention-shaped output
official_module_producer.consumer_packet: M=384 deterministic input IDs 0..383 reshaped [32,12]; local [384,32,256] Q with [384,16,256] K/V and global [384,32,512] Q with [384,4,512] K/V; future component capture must add the pinned SGLang page indices, request IDs, causal mask, stock paged attention and o_proj output.

exercise.local: Gemma4TextAttention layer 0 sliding_attention loaded strict state and exercised Q/K/V, norms, RoPE and o_proj
exercise.global: Gemma4TextAttention layer 5 full_attention loaded strict state and exercised Q/K (K=V per exact k_eq_v configuration), norms, RoPE and o_proj
